allow: PowerShell($tools = @\("git","node","npm","python","docker","gitea"\); foreach \($t in $tools\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "$t -> $\($c.Source\)" } else { "$t -> NOT FOUND" } })

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { $conns | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "Stopped PID $\($_.OwningProcess\)" } } else { "No listener on 8000" })
